sections.Profile:
"Subway" is a 1966 pinball machine by Bally that immerses players in the bustling atmosphere of a city subway system. Designed by Ted Zale with artwork by George Molentin, it features a subway-themed playfield, complete with subway cars and stations, delivering a unique urban experience.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1966–1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Roller Coaster, Single Player, Carnival, Transportation, City, Theme park
